about: Guided tour, the same for every site (no site names here). Each step: title, text (one sentence), optional date and play_to (a YYYY-MM-DD date, or "start" / "end" for the site's first and last day), note (shown on the timeline), change_verdict (opens the largest change with that label; without one, the largest change), show ("filter": open the site drawer on the list of changes, where the Filter block is) and focus (a CSS selector of the control to outline).

steps.title: Marked areas
steps.text: Each shape is a place where the land changed.

steps.title: Watch it happen
steps.text: Changes appear in the order they were seen.

steps.title: Radar and Satellite
steps.text: Switch the picture, or drag Compare to see before and after.

steps.title: Why a label
steps.text: Open a change to see its label, reasons and sources.

steps.title: Filter
steps.text: Pick a time frame and draw, type or upload an area to see only the changes inside it.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: Download the changes you see as CSV, GeoJSON, shapefile or GeoTIFF.

steps.title: Base map
steps.text: Switch the map behind the picture between Satellite and Light.
